stopping_requirements: All existing true-operator endpoint gates, global 2/0 Aufbau map/gap, storage P12/P13 and full reference T06; commuting excited determinant alone is insufficient.

required_method_decisions.question: Which state is intended: global closed-shell projected fixed point or a specified local/block occupancy state?
Which density/orbital variations are allowed, and what relationship must hold between G, projected F and E?
How are near-degenerate occupied boundaries, comparable roots and the retained final gap gate interpreted?
What operational energy interpretation and research restrictions are accepted?

before_any_new_scientific_execution: Freeze a new implementation/solver contract after method decisions, including exact parameters and rejection policy.
Complete independent, meaningful guarded engineering tests; do not transfer the old 122 PASS to new code.
Register fresh fixed fixture, same D, all comparison thresholds, process/evaluation/time/memory limits and authorization.
Record all actual current/candidate/returned operator states and projector identities.
Settle old budgets and preserve every old failure; no automatic retry, fixture switch or tolerance relaxation.

method_role_policy: Method owner defines target; external reviewer checks consistency; separate findings and disagreements in MDR-001. Legacy blank responsibility object is not a joint approval.
